scope: Source-evidence and literal guidance/actual comparison on the existing as-retrieved panel; no acquisition or model fitting
alignment: Every target is joined only to the immediately preceding quarter's document, with explicit target-quarter text checked in the document
interval_convention: Printed finite lower/upper percentages are treated as a closed descriptive interval; no midpoint or implied confidence level
qualitative_policy: Approximately/close-to/low-mid-high ranges and relative statements stay unscored; never invent tolerances, endpoints or point forecasts
lower_bound_policy: Keep strict operator and condition; optionally display literal threshold comparison to actual as arithmetic, outside all finite-interval aggregates
conditions: Keep FX assumptions and earthquake/FX qualifications. Whether assumptions materialized is not verified. Realized containment is not a test of conditional forecast skill
comparison_policy: Do not compare interval distance with point-MAE as if they were the same score; widening intervals mechanically reduces interval distance
missing_policy: All 24 origin documents and all 16 requested issuer-target rows remain present; unavailable guidance is not a miss or a zero
claims: Retrospective selected-document comparison only. No strict PIT, first-publication, holdout, causal, trading or forecast-skill claim. All historical-model readiness remains false
